{"problem": "遥测密文解码任务
已知密文 OHZEGXLZOCFIGMVWQZCRKZRKOTQULAKNURANKKUDZBTKQCRJMJVFLT
请先删除全部非字母字符 将剩余字母按顺序分成 18 组 每组长度 3
大写字母映射为索引 A为0 B为1 依此类推到Z为25 对每组索引按下述方式聚合 其中 sum 表示所有索引相加 alt 表示按位置交替相加减 起始由本题给出 weighted 表示按给定权重向量逐项相乘后相加 聚合得到的值再根据偏移策略与偏移量处理 若为 minus 则用聚合值减去偏移 若为 plus 则用聚合值加上偏移 最后对二十六取模得到0到25 将其映射回字母 A到Z 拼接得到明文
参数汇总 模式 alt 偏移策略 加上偏移 偏移量 11 交替起点 先减 权重 不适用 分组长度 3
聚合与偏移规则描述 本题采用 alt 规则 分组长度为 3 若是交替规则则先减再按加减交替 权重配置为 不适用 聚合值与偏移关系为加上偏移 11 并以二十六为模映射回字母
请回答三问
一 明文 答案格式 [[明文]] 示例 [[ABC]]
二 清理并分组后的字符串列表 严格使用英文括号与英文逗号加空格分隔 答案格式 (组1, 组2, ...) 示例 (AB, CD)
三 每组在加偏移前的聚合值列表 这些值为对二十六取模后的结果 答案格式 (a1, a2, ...)", "canonical_answer": "[[FQLGWGQTACUHRGMRNY]]====(OHZ, EGX, LZO, CFI, GMV, WQZ, CRK, ZRK, OTQ, ULA, KNU, RAN, KKU, DZB, TKQ, CRJ, MJV, FLT)====(20, 5, 0, 21, 11, 21, 5, 8, 15, 17, 9, 22, 6, 21, 1, 6, 2, 13)", "attempts": [{"panel": 0, "sample": 0, "answer": {"一": "[[RGLQAQGDWUCPFQKFJY]", "二": "(OHZ, EGX, LZO, CFI, GMV, WQZ, CRK, ZRK, OTQ, ULA, KNU, RAN, KKU, DZB, TKQ, CRJ, MJV, FLT)", "三": "(6, 21, 0, 5, 15, 5, 21, 18, 11, 9, 17, 4, 20, 5, 25, 20, 24, 13)"}, "certificate": "按 A=0,...,Z=25，对每组三字母计算 alt=x1−x2+x3，再模26，并加11取模。各组聚合值为 (6,21,0,5,15,5,21,18,11,9,17,4,20,5,25,20,24,13)，加11后映射得到 RGLQAQGDWUCPFQKFJY。清理后共54个字母，正好分为18组。"}]}

message.content: {"verdict":"valid","reason":"The cleaned ciphertext has 54 letters, yielding exactly 18 groups of 3. Interpreting “先减” as -x1+x2-x3, the first groups give OHZ: -14+7-25 ≡ 20 and EGX: -4+6-23 ≡ 5 (mod 26), matching the canonical aggregate list; adding 11 then produces F and Q, matching the canonical plaintext. The supplied attempt instead uses x1-x2+x3, so it is demonstrably incorrect.","error_types":[],"depth_score":2,"depth_evidence":"Each group requires letter-to-index conversion followed by alternating signed aggregation, then the resulting residue must be shifted by 11 and mapped back to a letter. The sign convention is essential and must be applied consistently across all 18 groups.","reasoning_type_tags":["arithmetic","cipher"],"constraint_type_tags":["string"],"scenario":"language","explanation_score":0,"explanation_evidence":"The certificate explicitly computes alt as x1−x2+x3, but the stated rule “先减” requires −x1+x2−x3. For example, OHZ is reported as 6 by the certificate, whereas the required residue is 20; consequently its plaintext is also wrong.","solver_correct":[false]}
